rules.name: Pre-existing diseases
rules.notes: Measured from first policy inception with insurer; reduced by prior continuous coverage (portability). Applies afresh to enhanced SI. PED window: diagnosed/treated within 36 months before policy start (Def. 35).

rules.name: Specified disease/procedure
rules.notes: If a listed item is also PED, the longer waiting period applies (C.1.b.iii).

rules.name: 30-day waiting period
rules.notes: Does not apply if the insured has continuous coverage for more than 12 months.

specified_illnesses: Diseases of gall bladder including cholecystitis
Calculus diseases of urogenital system e.g. kidney stone, urinary bladder stone
Benign tumors, cysts, nodules, polyps including breast lumps
Ulcer and erosion of stomach and duodenum
Cataract and other disorders of lens and retina
Fissure/fistula in anus, haemorrhoids including gout and rheumatism
specified_surgical_procedures: Surgery for prolapsed inter vertebral disc
Surgery of genito urinary system unless necessitated by malignancy
Surgery for varicose veins and varicose ulcers
